usedFor: Debounce checks whether an email address is valid with “Verify Email Address” and returns the verification detail.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Verify Email Address” in Debounce
bestTemplate.why: The action checks an address and returns verification detail, so bad addresses show up before any follow-up.

watchOut: “Verify Email Address” checks a single address per run, so a list needs one run for each.
